card: महाभारत की कहानी: प्यासे पांडव एक तालाब पर पहुँचते हैं। यक्ष कहता है कि पहले सवालों के जवाब दो, फिर पानी पियो। चार भाई बात नहीं मानते, पर युधिष्ठिर समझदारी से जवाब देते हैं।

Mahabharat ki kahani: pyaase Pandav ek taalaab par pahunchte hain. Yaksha kehta hai ki pehle sawaalon ke jawab do, phir paani piyo. Chaar bhai baat nahi maante, par Yudhishthir samajhdaari se jawab dete hain.
A story from the Mahabharata: the thirsty Pandavas reach a pool. A Yaksha says: answer my questions first, then drink. Four brothers don't listen, but Yudhishthira answers wisely.

q: What do you know about the Mahabharata?
महाभारत के बारे में क्या जानते हो?
Mahabharat ke baare mein kya jaante ho?
It is an epic about the Pandavas and the Kauravas.
It is an epic about the Pandavas and the Kauravas.
The Mahabharata is a great Indian epic written by Ved Vyas. It tells the story of the war between the Pandavas and the Kauravas.
महाभारत वेद व्यास का लिखा महान भारतीय महाकाव्य है। इसमें पांडवों और कौरवों के युद्ध की कहानी है।
Mahabharat Ved Vyas ka likha mahaan Bharatiya mahaakaavya hai. Ismein Pandavon aur Kauravon ke yuddh ki kahani hai.
Why were the Pandavas sent into exile?
They lost a game of dice to the Kauravas.
They lost a game of dice to the Kauravas.
The Pandavas were sent into exile because Yudhishthira lost a game of dice to the Kauravas, who cheated.
पांडवों को वनवास मिला क्योंकि युधिष्ठिर कौरवों से जुए (चौसर) में हार गए, जिसमें धोखा हुआ था।
Pandavon ko vanvaas mila kyonki Yudhishthir Kauravon se jue (chausar) mein haar gaye, jismein dhokha hua tha.
What difficulties did they face in exile?
They lived in forests without food, water or comfort.
They lived in forests without food, water or comfort.
In exile they wandered in forests, faced hunger, thirst, wild animals and many dangers.
वनवास में वे जंगलों में भटके और भूख, प्यास, जंगली जानवरों और कई ख़तरों का सामना किया।
Vanvaas mein woh junglon mein bhatke aur bhookh, pyaas, jungli jaanwaron aur kai khatron ka saamna kiya.

q: What did Yudhishthira say to Nakula?
युधिष्ठिर ने नकुल से क्या कहा?
Yudhishthir ne Nakul se kya kaha?
Climb the tree and look for signs of water nearby.
Climb the tree and look for signs of water nearby.
Yudhishthira told Nakula to climb a tree and look all over the forest for water, because trees, birds and plants are sure signs of water.
युधिष्ठिर ने नकुल से पेड़ पर चढ़कर पूरे जंगल में पानी देखने को कहा, क्योंकि पेड़, पक्षी और पौधे पानी के पक्के निशान हैं।
Yudhishthir ne Nakul se ped par chadhkar poore jungle mein paani dekhne ko kaha, kyonki ped, pakshi aur paudhe paani ke pakke nishaan hain.
What did the voice from the pond say?
तालाब की आवाज़ ने क्या कहा?
Taalaab ki awaaz ne kya kaha?
Answer my questions before drinking, or you will die.
Drink as much as you like.
Answer my questions before drinking, or you will die.
The voice said, ‘Stop! Do not drink the water till you have answered my questions. If you take even a drop before this, you may die at once.’
आवाज़ ने कहा, ‘रुको! मेरे सवालों के जवाब दिए बिना पानी मत पियो। एक बूँद भी पी तो तुरंत मर सकते हो।’
Awaaz ne kaha, ‘Ruko! Mere sawaalon ke jawab diye bina paani mat piyo. Ek boond bhi pi to turant mar sakte ho.’
Did Nakula pay heed to the voice?
क्या नकुल ने आवाज़ पर ध्यान दिया?
Kya Nakul ne awaaz par dhyaan diya?
No, he drank the water and fell dead.
Yes, he answered all the questions.
No, he drank the water and fell dead.
No, Nakula paid no heed to the voice. He touched the water and fell dead.
नहीं, नकुल ने ध्यान नहीं दिया। पानी छूते ही वह मर गया।
Nahi, Nakul ne dhyaan nahi diya. Paani chhoote hi woh mar gaya.
Which is one of the Yaksha's questions?
यक्ष का एक सवाल कौन सा था?
Yaksha ka ek sawaal kaun sa tha?
Which is the best road to Heaven?
Which is the best road to Heaven?

Some of the Yaksha's questions: Which is the best road to Heaven? Which is the best of virtues? Which is the worst enemy of man? What is heavier than the earth and the clouds? What is the way to be happy?
यक्ष के कुछ सवाल: स्वर्ग का सबसे अच्छा रास्ता? सबसे अच्छा गुण? इंसान का सबसे बड़ा दुश्मन? धरती और बादलों से भारी क्या? ख़ुश रहने का तरीक़ा?
Yaksha ke kuchh sawaal: swarg ka sabse achha raasta? Sabse achha gun? Insaan ka sabse bada dushman? Dharti aur baadalon se bhaari kya? Khush rehne ka tareeqa?
Which is the best of all virtues?
सबसे अच्छा गुण कौन सा है?
Sabse achha gun kaun sa hai?
The best virtue is to hate none.
सबसे अच्छा गुण है किसी से नफ़रत न करना।
Sabse achha gun hai kisi se nafrat na karna.
Why did Yudhishthira wish to get back Nakula?
युधिष्ठिर ने नकुल को ही क्यों माँगा?
Yudhishthir ne Nakul ko hi kyon maanga?
So that one son of each mother, Kunti and Madri, stays alive.
Because he did not love Bhima and Arjuna.
So that one son of each mother, Kunti and Madri, stays alive.
Yudhishthira was the son of Kunti and Nakula was the son of Madri. He wanted Nakula back so that one son of each mother would remain alive.
युधिष्ठिर कुंती के बेटे थे और नकुल माद्री के। वे चाहते थे कि दोनों माताओं का एक-एक बेटा जीवित रहे।
Yudhishthir Kunti ke bete the aur Nakul Maadri ke. Woh chahte the ki dono maataon ka ek-ek beta jeevit rahe.
How did the four brothers come back to life?
चारों भाई दोबारा कैसे जीवित हुए?
Chaaron bhai dobaara kaise jeevit hue?
The Yaksha sprinkled water on them.
They woke up on their own.
The Yaksha sprinkled water on them.
The Yaksha, who was really Dharma, the God of Justice, was pleased with Yudhishthira. He sprinkled some drops of water on the four brothers and they came back to life.
यक्ष असल में धर्मराज (न्याय के देवता) थे। युधिष्ठिर से ख़ुश होकर उन्होंने चारों भाइयों पर पानी छिड़का और वे जीवित हो गए।
Yaksha asal mein Dharmaraj (nyaay ke devta) the. Yudhishthir se khush hokar unhone chaaron bhaiyon par paani chhidka aur woh jeevit ho gaye.
What moral do you draw from this story?
Virtue, patience and justice always pay.
Virtue, patience and justice always pay.
The moral is that virtue pays. We should be patient, wise and just, and listen before we act.
सीख: सद्गुण का फल मिलता है। हमें धैर्य, समझदारी और न्याय से काम लेना चाहिए, और करने से पहले सुनना चाहिए।

card: can = योग्यता (I can swim), can't = नहीं कर सकते, could = बीते समय की योग्यता या विनम्र अनुमति, may = अनुमति (May I come in?), might/could = आगे की संभावना (It might rain)।
can = yogyata (I can swim), can't = nahi kar sakte, could = beete samay ki yogyata ya vinamra anumati, may = anumati (May I come in?), might/could = aage ki sambhaavna (It might rain).
can = ability, can't = inability, could = past ability or polite permission, may = permission, might/could = future possibility.
